direction.name: Loud and flat
direction.idea: A page with the directness of a street poster: flat saturated colour, the heaviest type you can find, short blunt statements, and photographs cut out and stuck on. It is for subjects with a voice. Write the page as things a person would actually say out loud, and let the design say them at full volume. The craft is in the control beneath the noise: a strict grid, two or three colours, and exact alignment keep it from becoming a mess.
direction.composition: Hero: a statement of three to six words in ultra-heavy type at 11–15vw, filling the width, lines stacked tight (leading 0.85), flush left with 20–28px margins, on a flat saturated ground. One cut-out or hard-cropped photograph overlaps the type from the right or bottom, tilted 3–6 degrees. A single chunky button in the contrasting flat colour. Sections are solid panels in alternating palette colours: one is a row of short statements each on its own panel of unequal width; one is a single photograph bleeding off two edges with a caption block set over a solid colour bar; one is a large plain list. Panels meet edge to edge. Corners are square or use one large radius (28–40px) consistently.
direction.typography: The heaviest weight available, set tight, mostly lowercase or mostly uppercase (choose one). Body text is a plain grotesk at 18–20px.
direction.colour: Three or four flat colours at full strength including black or white. Each panel is one colour; text on it is one other.
direction.imagery: Photographs with attitude, cropped hard or cut to a simple shape with `clip-path` (circle, arch, blunt polygon), slightly rotated, overlapping the type. Two or three on the page.
direction.richness: Colour mass, type mass, and overlap.
direction.pitfalls: Headlines still obey the two-line rule: at 13vw that means very few words, which is correct for this voice. No outlines, no offset shadows, no sticker confetti. Rotation is for two or three images only, never for text blocks.

hero.name: Waterline headline
hero.blueprint: Two flat fields fill the viewport and meet at exactly half height: the upper one paper or white, the lower one a saturated palette colour. No image. The headline is two lines of capitals in a black-weight grotesk at clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px), centred, leading 0.86, about 65% of the viewport wide, positioned so the seam cuts through the middle of the second line. Above the seam the letters take the accent ink; below it they switch to a deep ink, as if under water. Build it with two stacked copies of the headline in the same position (the lower copy aria-hidden), each clipped to its own field with clip-path: inset(), or with mix-blend-mode: difference on a single copy if the colours allow. The wordmark sits top-left and the single action, a solid rectangle in the accent ink, top-right, both on 28px margins; there are no other links. Near the bottom, 40px above the edge, one supporting sentence at 20px is centred in the paper colour on the saturated field. Everything else is empty colour.
hero.mobile: The same two fields, meeting at 46% of the height. The headline sets at 15.5vw on two lines, filling the width inside 16px margins, the seam still cutting the second line. The wordmark sits top-left and the action top-right as a small solid rectangle. The supporting sentence sits bottom-left at 17px on the saturated field, on up to three lines.
hero.headline: A blunt statement of 2-4 words in capitals, at most 20 characters, split so each line is one or two words.

type.note: A soft geometric sans with wide round letters and relaxed joins, warm at semibold and easy at text size. Suits consumer apps, community products, cafes and small friendly brands.

palette.name: Blue, red, black
palette.note: Three flat poster colours each own whole sections: electric blue, red-orange and black, with white for the areas that show the product. No tints sit between them, and blue is the button colour on white.

photos.title: Fog and quiet
photos.note: misty, muted, minimal landscapes and empty horizons; calm areas for text

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Staircase statement
sections.blueprint: On a flat dark or saturated field one sentence of 12–18 words is broken into five short lines at clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 64px), bold, leading 1.02, marked up as one paragraph (a statement, so it may run past two lines at this size). Each line starts further right than the one above: indents of 0, 6, 12, 18 and 24vw from a 4vw left margin, set with `padding-left` per line, so the block descends like stairs and ends near the 75% mark. Each line takes its own flat colour from the palette, or lines alternate between two inks. The block is vertically centred in a section 100svh tall. The right quarter (columns 10–12) holds two stacked photographs, each 3:2 and 20vw wide with a 16px gap, top-aligned with the first line. No heading; a two-line note at 15px sits at the bottom-left margin, on the first line's left edge. On a page without images, leave the right quarter empty.
sections.mobile: Five lines at 9vw (35px on a 390px screen) with indents of 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20vw, so the stair still reads on a 390px screen. The two photographs follow below as one row of two equal 3:2 frames. The note sits last, left-aligned.

sections.name: Stacked folders with tabs
sections.blueprint: Projects are filed as folders: four to six full-width flat colour bands stacked so that each shows a 64px strip above the next, built with `position: sticky` and increasing `top` offsets (0, 64, 128px) so the bands pile up as the page scrolls. From the top-left edge of each band one or two tabs rise: filled shapes 44px tall and 200–320px wide with shouldered corners cut by `clip-path: polygon()` or an inline SVG path, side by side with 6px gaps, each in a flat colour that contrasts with its band. The project name sits inside the tab at 26–28px; the category sits right-aligned in the band's visible strip at 15px. An open band is 80svh: a 16:10 photograph in columns 1–7 and, top-aligned in columns 9–12, a 60-word description with a link. A two-word heading at 32px precedes the stack.
sections.mobile: Bands do not stick; they stack in normal flow, each led by one tab 40px tall with the name at 20px and the category beside it. Inside a band the photograph is full width at 4:3 with the description beneath at 16px and 20px padding.

sections.name: Pinned heading, passing rows
sections.blueprint: One flat saturated field, full-bleed, as tall as its content. Columns 1–5: the heading, two or three words, at clamp(56px, 6.6vw, 104px) in the heaviest weight, position: sticky; top: 32px, so it holds while the right side travels. Columns 7–12: four to six capability blocks stacked with 120px between them. Each block is a title at 28px bold, then a two-part row: a portrait photograph at 3:4, 180–220px wide with square corners, and beside it, top-aligned, a plain list of four to six short lines at 18px with 14px between lines. Photographs alternate between the left and the right of their list, so the column does not read as a ladder. One ink colour, chosen for contrast on the field. The heading releases when the bottom of the last block reaches it.
sections.mobile: The heading becomes a sticky bar at the top of the section: one line at 9vw on the field colour with 12px padding, holding while blocks pass under it. Each block stacks its title, a full-width 4:3 photograph, then the list at 17px. 72px between blocks.

sections.name: Team on colour tiles
sections.blueprint: A one-line heading of two or three words at 28–36px sits top-left; nothing sits to its right. 40px below, a grid of portrait tiles: six columns with 12px gaps across the full content width for 12 or more people, four columns for 4–8. Every tile is a 4:5 photograph treated identically so mixed-quality headshots look like one set: `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.15)` with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` over a flat tint, the tints rotating through four palette colours in a fixed order. Square corners or one small radius. Under each tile, left-aligned to its edge with 10px of space: the name at 15px in full ink and the role at 13px in the soft ink, up to two lines. Rows are 36px apart. A leftover tile in the last row stays at the left; it is not centred. No hover lift and no social icons.
sections.mobile: Two columns with 8px gaps; tiles stay 4:5 with names at 14px beneath. For more than ten people, switch to three columns and show the name only. The heading sits above at 24px. Tints keep their rotation, so the grid reads as a checkerboard of colours.

sections.name: Question at both edges
sections.blueprint: For a closing choice between two answers: book or ask, this date or that, the tasting or the tour. A flat field exactly 100svh tall in the darkest tone. The question is a two-line heading at clamp(110px, 11vw, 168px), leading 1.0, centred, about 54% of the width: line one with its cap line 32px under the field's top edge, line two with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The band of about 560px between them is empty except for one row at its optical centre: two solid rectangular buttons, each about 200×56px with its label at 18px in medium weight, their inner edges 120px either side of the centre axis, and between them, exactly on the axis, the word 'or' at 18px in the soft ink. 16px under the row, centred, one line at 16px in the soft ink says what happens after either choice. The type above and below closes the empty band, so it reads as held breath rather than a gap.
sections.mobile: The question drops to 18vw, still two centred lines, line one 32px from the top and line two 24px above the bottom. The buttons stack at the centre at 72% of the width, 12px apart, with 'or' between them and the line of explanation under the second.

sections.name: Photograph half, menu half
sections.blueprint: A split footer one viewport tall. The left half is a single photograph filling columns 1–6 edge to edge, cropped hard by the left and bottom viewport edges: a close crop of the page's main subject, larger than it appeared anywhere above. The right half, on a flat field, is the site's menu set large: five or six section names stacked as links at about 2.6vw bold, 28px apart, starting at column 8 and 80px from the top. Rows are separated by space only; on hover a row's label shifts right by 12px and the others drop to the softer ink. Under the menu, 64px lower, two short blocks at 15px side by side: contact and social. The legal line runs along the very bottom of the right half at 12px. The wordmark sits small at the top of the right half, on the menu's left edge.
sections.mobile: The photograph leads at full width and 50svh, cropped tight. The menu follows on the flat field at 8vw per item with 20px between items, then contact and social stacked at 15px, then the legal line at 12px. The wordmark sits small above the menu.

references.name: Trevor Noah
references.idea: The comedian as a paper cut-out sticker: his head is torn open and the things he makes (stand-up, books, video) spill out and become the navigation.
references.hero: The desktop capture caught a blank navy frame before the canvas painted; the next frame and the mobile shot show the scene. A deep navy field. The name runs across the top in bold pink grotesk on one line, sized to nearly touch both edges. Centred below is a photographic cut-out of the face with a thick white sticker outline and a torn top edge, from which glossy 3D objects (microphone, book, video player, brain, heart) erupt. Circular arrow buttons sit at the left and right edges; a torn-paper white label beneath the face names the current category. A hairline, a text ticker and a pink pill close the bottom.
references.type: Die Grotesk D bold for the wordmark (361px in the digest), Die Grotesk C for everything else with body near 19px. Tight tracking, title case. Statements run at about 4vw and emphasise words by switching them to pink, never by changing weight or face.
references.colour: #1d2440 #f78fb3 #f6f7ee #2b2b2b — One navy field for the entire page. Pink marks the wordmark, emphasised words and one pill; cream-white fills buttons and paper shapes. Photos bring the only other colour.
references.imagery: Photo cut-outs of the face with thick white die-cut outlines and torn edges, toy-like 3D objects, and small stage photos shaped as peeling stickers or rounded tiles, tilted a few degrees and loosely clustered.
references.layout: Centred, one idea per screen on an unbroken navy ground: statement, section title with drifting objects, a lone pill button. The fixed header has the pink name left and two cream pills right. Elements enter from the edges and overlap instead of sitting in columns.

sections.description: A centred four-line statement in white at about 4vw, the lines stepped and ragged instead of squared off, with one long word in pink on the first line. It occupies the lower half of the viewport while the upper half stays empty navy, and appears to build line by line.

A two-line centred title, first line white and second pink, at about 2.5vw. Beneath it a loose cluster of tilted objects rises from the bottom edge: a 3D video-player tile in the middle, small rounded photo tiles and a 3D microphone to its left, all overlapping. On the next screen the objects have drifted upward past a single cream pill button centred in empty space.

Split footer. Left half: a second, larger cut-out of the face, tilted and cropped by the left and bottom edges, with a small white speech bubble above it. Right half: a five-row menu, each row a tiny index number at left and a bold label at about 2.5vw, separated by hairlines. Legal text is tiny along the bottom.

steal: Cut the subject out of a photo with a thick white sticker border and a torn edge so photography behaves like illustration.
Emphasise words in a statement by colour alone (pink within white) while keeping one face and one weight.
Turn the footer into a large numbered menu beside a cropped portrait whose speech bubble addresses the departing visitor.
references.media: Media covers essentially the whole first screen: a fixed WebGL layer behind everything, a photographic cut-out of the face with a torn top taking about a third of the width and the bottom two thirds of the height, props bursting out of it over the wordmark. Later the props re-form into a collage of tilted sticker photos round a 3D object and a stack of books, torn-paper strips mark the colour changes, and a giant cropped portrait peeks from the footer corner, every photo an alpha cut-out with an 8-10px white sticker outline and no video anywhere.
references.motion: A load of about 7.3s plays as a large counter to 100, the intact face sticker, the crown tearing away, props spilling out and the name last, and Lenis then drives the fixed WebGL stage as the props fly down and re-form per chapter, the ground changing navy, charcoal, navy at torn-paper dividers. Headline lines rise from translateY(120%) through a clip-path over 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1) and stickers pop in from scale 0 on an overshoot curve the house layer does not use, while 11 reduced-motion rules zero every duration.

references.name: Aardvark Book Club
references.idea: A book club dressed as a sweet shop: fat black type, tumbling 3D books and boxes on wavy colour fields, annotated with handwritten asides.
references.hero: A saturated yellow field with two large wavy blobs, pale yellow then orange, rising from the bottom. A three-line headline in Champ Bold, black, at about 8.3vw with leading under 0.85, is flush to a 15px left margin and reaches 60% across. Beneath it: a four-line paragraph 310px wide and a magenta split button (label plus arrow square). Right of centre a 3D hardback in navy and pink tilts 20 degrees, 600px tall; another book is cropped by the top-left corner, a third by the bottom edge. A purple handwritten note sits rotated at far right. Nav: pale-yellow pill links centred, an orange login button, black round social icons.
references.type: Champ Bold, an ultra-heavy wide sans with a looped g, for headings at 120px with tight tracking and leading; Degular for 18px body and pill labels; a purple handwritten script (Hello Organichand) for rotated margin notes and step labels. Three distinct voices.
references.colour: #ffd249 #faed8f #f9a21f #ffdbfd #a4f6f8 #fd48f2 — Each section owns one flat candy colour: yellow hero, white shelf, pink steps, cyan unboxing, deep violet footer. Type stays black; buttons are magenta.
references.imagery: 3D-rendered hardbacks and a patterned shipping box, cut out and tilted, floating over flat wavy vector shapes; real book covers on tilted coloured cards; black line drawings of figures on step cards. Nothing sits square to the grid.
references.layout: Sections are full-width panels with roughly 80px corner radius inset about 20px from the viewport, each a different colour. Headings alternate left and centre; cards overlap and rotate a few degrees; handwritten notes are tucked beside headings at an angle.

sections.description: White band. A centred black heading at 5.5vw over a two-line subline, with a rotated handwritten note at its upper left. Below, a horizontal row of book covers, each on a rounded colour-matched card with a small tag pill at top-left; cards tilt alternately by 3 degrees at staggered heights, the last cropped by the right edge, with two round arrow buttons above at right. Later, covers give way to same-coloured info cards with genre pills, heavy title and blurb.

A pale-pink rounded panel with lighter wavy shapes inside. Heavy black heading at left with a handwritten aside beside it; a small round logo stamp and a magenta split button at right. Along the bottom, four portrait cards about 250px wide in cyan, magenta, yellow and violet overlap like a fanned hand, each rotated a few degrees, with a handwritten step label at top, a black line drawing in the middle and a heavy caption at the foot.

A full-viewport cyan rounded panel containing only a 3D shipping box wrapped in a wavy magenta, violet and black pattern, centred. Across the scroll it goes from closed and tilted to lid open, growing to about 57% of the viewport width, with a single handwritten note at its right. No heading and no button.

The preceding white section ends in large rounded bottom corners over a deep violet footer. Left: white logo, two store badges, two magenta round social icons. Centre: the patterned box again, cropped by the bottom edge. Right: a small heavy heading, a white rounded email field and a magenta split button. A black legal strip closes the page.

steal: Give each section one flat saturated colour inside a large-radius inset panel and keep the type black across all of them.
Add rotated handwritten margin notes beside headings to carry secondary facts in a second voice.
Fan step cards so they overlap and tilt instead of sitting in an even grid.
references.media: About 60% of the first screen is picture: a 3D book and cropped book corners over a full-bleed illustrated wave field. Below come a sticky image-sequence of a box opening inside a rounded panel, a slider of tilted cards bleeding off the right edge, covers fanned like a hand of cards, a sticker collage round a circular badge and a cut-out box rising out of the footer: 37 images and two scroll-scrubbed canvases, no video.
references.motion: An indigo transition panel wipes away by 1.2s while the headline arrives word by word (515 split characters), and Lenis then drives the scrubbed scenes: the hero book turns through an image sequence, a sticky stage scrubs the box opening over 2745px, a headline slides along a curved path at scrub 0.5, and the footer is uncovered from under the rounded page. Buttons squash to 0.955 by 0.925 in 0.15s on press, the main ease is cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), and the bounce overshoots are ones the house motion layer does not use, though the site ships 32 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: PX PUSH
references.idea: A design subscription presented as a retro broadcast: the entire site is seen through a CRT screen, with a chrome logo token floating in the sky as its mascot.
references.hero: Full-bleed photograph of deep-blue sky over a cloud bank, the whole viewport under a CRT treatment: horizontal scanlines, slight blur, dark vignette with rounded corners. Top row with 43px margins: thin techno wordmark left; three links and a start link with a green dot right, split by a vertical hairline; full-width hairline beneath. Then one marquee line at 12vw (173px) in off-white grotesk, cropped at both edges, words separated by a solid dot, closed by a second hairline. Dead centre: a chrome 3D ring token about 400px wide. Bottom-left: a 216×144px royal-blue rounded thumbnail with a two-line mono caption. Bottom-right: a four-line mono uppercase paragraph 450px wide.
references.type: A semi-condensed grotesk (digest name 'SemiSqueezed') at regular weight carries the 173px marquee, 28px paragraphs and 5vw statements; an uppercase monospace at 11–17px handles tags, captions and link rows. Ten-to-one jump between display and labels; no bold anywhere.
references.colour: #03049c #71737d #1a1a1a #788ca4 #d9dde6 #c8f31d — Each section is a full colour field: sky photo, mid grey, near-black, then saturated royal blue. Text is off-white or pale lavender; acid lime appears only in small thumbnails, green only as a status dot.
references.imagery: Sky photograph, a chrome 3D logo token, and client work shown as phone UIs on a blue ground and a poster photographed in a street lightbox. Everything sits under the same scanline filter; tiles have small radii.
references.layout: A narrow left rail (about 17% wide) carries a bullet, a mono section tag and a small pinned thumbnail; copy starts at 35% and runs to the right margin. Hairline rules and arrow link rows divide content. Each section switches the full background colour.

sections.description: Mid-grey field. In the left rail: a bullet and mono tag at the top, and a 115×75px acid-lime thumbnail with a black glyph pinned lower-left that swaps as you scroll. The right 60% holds one long paragraph at about 28px with tight leading, opened by an arrow and a deep first-line indent; words go from white to grey with scroll progress. It ends with two full-width hairline rows in mono, arrow at the far right.

Near-black field. A horizontal strip of large tiles about 500px tall with narrow gaps, bleeding off the left edge: a royal-blue tile with three phone screens in a row, then a photograph of a poster in a street lightbox. Below, the left rail shows a bullet and tag while a four-line mono caption sits in the content column.

Saturated royal-blue field. A three-line statement in pale lavender at roughly 5vw sits left-aligned at the 35% column, vertically centred in an otherwise empty screen. Below a full-width hairline, each benefit is a row: mono number in the rail, a 3vw title, a narrow mono paragraph under it, and a small photo (a windsock against sky) pinned to the right margin.

Same blue. The wordmark is enlarged to 95% of the width in pale lavender with a slit-scan echo: horizontal slices of the letter tops repeat upward in fading bands. Underneath, a mono address block sits in the rail, and two columns of hairline link rows with corner arrows fill the content area.

steal: Apply one global post-effect (scanlines plus a rounded vignette) over the whole viewport so photos, UI mocks and type all belong to the same screen.
Run the headline as a single cropped marquee line boxed between two hairlines under the nav, leaving the rest of the hero for one object.
Keep a narrow left rail for a mono section tag and a small pinned thumbnail that swaps per section, with copy confined to the right 60%.
references.media: A full-bleed sky photograph covers the whole first screen with a chrome 3D token about 20% of the width at the centre and a small 216x144 video card docked bottom-left that changes clip and shape per chapter. Then a looping strip of mixed-width work images at a fixed 576px height, sticky rows each with a 4:5 portrait docked right, and a split with a fixed 3D floppy disk in the left half as price sheets scroll in the right; everything passes under fixed CRT layers: scanlines, a sweeping bright bar and a vignette.
references.motion: No preloader was captured (load 15.2s): between 400 and 2500ms the token turns from face-on to side-on and the marquee drifts, and under Lenis paragraphs split into characters (2001 elements) brighten word by word with the scroll from about 25% to full opacity, benefit rows stack as 90px sticky tabs, and the disk turns from edge-on to face-on. No cubic-beziers anywhere, only ease, linear and steps: a 0.5s stepped grain, an 8s scanline sweep and opacity 0.3s ease on hover, with no reduced-motion rule.
